name: @agentproto/pair-page
description: The per-daemon phone pair page (AIP-59): one static bundle served on every <fingerprint>.agentproto.cloud by a Cloudflare Worker. Pairs a browser with a daemon from an offer QR, then proxies the daemon's Control Center through a service worker over the E2E rendezvous tunnel.

scripts.check-types: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.sw.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json
